title: Benum
summary: BENUM', corruptly BENUMB', verb transitive 1. To make torpid; to deprive of sensation; as, a hand or foot benummed by cold. 2. To stupify; to render inactive; as, to benum the senses.

inlines.v: BENUM', corruptly BENUMB', verb transitive 1. To make torpid; to deprive of sensation; as, a hand or foot benummed by cold. 2. To stupify; to render inactive; as, to benum the senses.
